prior_review_verdict.response: Resolved both P1 review rejection findings on PR #5637 head dd7a119916: (1) Atomic Canonical Lock Window during Runtime Phase Commit (.orchestrator/supervisor.py): Held canonical_task_state_lock_file(status_file, shared=True) across save_runtime_state(config, scratch) in _run_reserved_runtime_phase, ensuring CAS revalidation and state save are atomic. Concurrent writers attempting to acquire canonical_task_state_lock_file are blocked by lock contention (writer_exit=73, writer_blocked_by_canonical_lock=true) and phase_committed remains true. Added permanent real two-process regression tests in test_supervisor.py (test_two_process_ordering_reserved_phase_save_window_locks_concurrent_writer and test_two_process_ordering_reserved_phase_drift_fences_deferred_termination). (2) Terminal Supersede and Compact Fact Shape Alignment (.orchestrator/supervisor.py): In active_worker_governance_lease_decision, aligned cancellation recognition with actual canonical terminal shape from ai_status.py command_supersede by checking task_terminal_outcome in {'cancelled', 'canceled', 'superseded'} alongside task_status_lower in {'cancelled', 'canceled', 'superseded'}. Added strict identity and generation validation against task_gen and worker_gen when resolving roles from worker request_snapshot or archive snapshot, preventing stale or foreign archive role borrowing. Added test_producer_to_consumer_supersede_retained_and_compact_shapes in test_supervisor.py verifying real producer command_supersede for both retained row and compact terminal fact shapes, resolving owner/reviewer and preserving ambiguity guards against unauthenticated actors, foreign archive snapshots, or mismatched generations.

defect_reproduced.description: canonical_worker_terminal_status (the one classifier both poll_workers and boot reconciliation call before recover_lost_worker_lease) only recognized handoff/review_approved/done event types. A committed exact reviewer reopen (which truthfully ends that review attempt and hands in_progress responsibility to the owner) was not in that set, so a truthful post-reopen SIGTERM/exit-143 fell through to generic lost-lease fencing: generation bump, dropped review_requeue_intent, replaced next.

See REVIEW_HANDOFF_RECOVERY_RECHECK.md.

changes.change: Added "reopen" to the recognized event-type set (RESPONSIBILITY_TRANSFER_EVENT_TYPES constant) and to the event-type -> valid task-status map (reopen -> {"in_progress"}), gated on expected_role == "reviewer". Fixed shared actor check so missing actor fails closed. Added self-consistent event_id check via _ai_status_activity_event_id_matches. Added worker_matches_current_task_generation check. Added review_requeue_intent cross-check requiring pending status, matching task_generation, and matching reviewer/reopened_by. Bound committed github_review_bridge to current task review bridge (head_sha, pr, actor, decision) and dispatched attempt PR delivery head_sha, rejecting conflicting present evidence. Strictly validates complete committed delivery and evidence manifest bindings against current task and dispatched snapshot.
Catches read exceptions and returns None on missing/unreadable canonical truth when status_file is configured, refusing stale task_map fallback when a row is deleted or unreadable.

Acquires canonical_task_state_lock_file(status_file, shared=True), reloads fresh canonical task and recent governance events from disk, revalidates task generation and canonical terminal status against expected outcome under lock, and atomically commits worker status = "completed" and queue event finalization.

Removed unknown-evidence fallback to True. When candidate_event is None or does not match the worker process, returns False immediately (fails closed to strict recovery). Only returns True when canonical_worker_terminal_status returns non-None, enforcing the single shared validated contract across both poll_workers and boot reconciliation call sites.

Converged onto the shared validated contract. Evaluates transfer and terminal activity before done_statuses. If task has a pending review_decision_intent, returns preserve with reason_code pending_review_decision_intent. For RESPONSIBILITY_TRANSFER_EVENT_TYPES events, delegates to canonical_worker_terminal_status: terminates with exact_worker_lifecycle_transition only when validated, and returns preserve with unvalidated_lifecycle_transition if unauthenticated or unvalidated (rejecting missing or forged event_id). For GOVERNANCE_TERMINAL_EVENT_TYPES, strictly checks process match, digest match, and authenticated actor match; recognizes task_terminal_outcome in {"cancelled", "canceled", "superseded"} alongside task_status in {"cancelled", "canceled", "superseded"}; validates generation matches against task_gen and worker_gen when resolving owner and reviewer from worker request_snapshot or archive snapshot (preventing stale archive role borrowing); terminal cancellation terminates with authorized_terminal_cancellation only when authenticated, matching generation, and issued by Human/Ops, Orchestrator, or assigned task owner/reviewer (failing closed to preserve for unconfigured actors, wrong roles, wrong generation, or missing actor; finalizing queue as cancelled).

Under lock/CAS immediately before effects, delegates to _revalidate_and_commit_worker_terminal_status before setting worker completed or finalizing queue events, eliminating stale task_map classification windows while cleanly fencing superseded workers under lock when generation or assignment drifts. Distinguishes authorized terminal cancellation from exact_worker_lifecycle_transition.

Under canonical_task_state_lock_file(status_file, shared=True) during final CAS revalidation through save_runtime_state(config, scratch), reloads fresh canonical task and verifies lease actions for deferred terminations, completed workers, and superseded workers against fresh state, setting cas_matches = False on drift, and holding the canonical lock across the entire save window so concurrent writers encounter lock contention (exit 73).

reopen_strict_authentication.detail: test_canonical_worker_terminal_status_reopen_strict_negatives, test_canonical_worker_terminal_status_and_active_lease_all_transfer_strict_negatives_and_positives, delivery/manifest binding tests, and new regression unit tests in RuntimeAndFailureSemanticsTests independently reproduce and reject every review probe: (1) drifted current review binding across head_sha, pr, actor, or decision (test_reopen_rejects_drifted_current_review_binding); (2) different valid-shaped dispatched PR head (test_reopen_rejects_different_dispatched_head); (3) missing canonical row refusing stale task_map fallback (test_missing_canonical_row_must_not_return_stale_task_map); (4) unreadable canonical state refusing stale task_map fallback (test_unreadable_canonical_state_must_not_return_stale_task_map); (5) assignment consumer refusing completion from deleted canonical row (test_assignment_consumer_must_not_complete_from_deleted_canonical_row); (6) worker bound to generation 1 replayed against generation 2; (7) event missing actor, forged event_id, or mismatched review_requeue_intent fields; (8) authentic positive baselines confirm matching authentic reopen and artifact/PR bindings succeed.

real_two_process_cli_taskstore_outbox_fl.detail: RealProcessReviewHandoffRecoveryFlowTests in .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py exercises 13 genuine multi-process flows with real worker_runner.py, local_stub sandbox, genuine runner exits writing runner status JSON markers, fresh supervisor process restart, and authentic queue consumer launch: (1) test_real_isolated_runner_stop_and_dispatch_flow: isolated child runner, real PID and /proc ticks, CLI ai-status.sh reopen commit, SIGTERM/exit 143, unmocked supervisor poll_workers & fresh restart reconciliation, dispatch_ready_tasks plans owner dispatch with review findings, and actual successor worker process executes verifying review_requeue_intent. (2) test_real_runner_queue_consumer_launches_exactly_one_owner_across_restart: real queue consumer process_queue launches owner worker from queued intent with captured findings across supervisor restart without duplicate launches. (3) test_real_runner_queue_receipt_restart_and_dispatch_flow: real runner exit (143), CLI reopen, unmocked poll_workers, fresh restart reconciliation, durable reserve_dispatch_plan queue receipt reservation, repeated dispatch cycle deduplication, and supervisor restart boot reconciliation preservation of the queued event to Antigravity. (4) test_two_process_ordering1_reopen_completes_before_recovery_cas: bounded overlapping processes with fail-closed dual multiprocessing.Barrier(2) synchronization, proving reopen commits before recovery CAS, recovery CAS fails safely, worker is superseded without bumping generation, and review findings remain intact. (5) test_two_process_ordering2_recovery_fences_stale_reopen_refused_by_cas: dual barrier concurrency proving recovery CAS commits first (bumping generation 1 -> 2), and concurrent stale reopen is refused by CAS preflight with exit code != 0. (6) test_two_process_ordering_handoff_completes_before_recovery_cas: dual barrier concurrency proving handoff commits before recovery CAS, worker superseded cleanly. (7) test_two_process_ordering_finalize_completes_before_recovery_cas: authentic finalize race using _child_done_finalize_worker, proving task finalized to done and archived while recovery CAS supersedes worker without lost-lease receipt. (8) test_two_process_ordering_assignment_stage_revalidation_fences_concurrent_reassign: concurrent reassignment bumps generation 1 -> 2 while assignment stage poll revalidates under lock and supersedes worker cleanly. (9) test_two_process_ordering_reassignment_fences_stale_reopen: dual barrier concurrency proving supervisor reassignment fences concurrent stale reopen, task advanced to reassigned owner. (10) test_crash_window_reopen_commit_runner_sigkill_restart: CLI reopen committed, runner abruptly killed via SIGKILL, and fresh supervisor restart boot reconciliation cleanly reaps the dead process as completed without lost-lease receipt, preserving task at generation 1. (11) test_crash_retry_window_outbox_committed_runner_terminated_receipt_retry: outbox committed, runner terminated (143), restart reconciliation, queue reservation, crash restart, repeated dispatch deduplication, and actual successor worker process execution verifying outbox reason. (12) test_two_process_ordering_reserved_phase_save_window_locks_concurrent_writer: proves canonical lock held across state save blocks concurrent writer with exit code 73. (13) test_two_process_ordering_reserved_phase_drift_fences_deferred_termination: proves canonical task mutation before phase revalidation safely sets cas_matches=False and aborts phase commit.
